name: stock-analysis
description: Reusable stock-analysis skill library for AI stock picking, A-share workflows, and Serenity equity research frameworks.

skills.name: ai-stock-picking
skills.description: Use when running a sector-first AI stock-picking workflow: find sectors, map industry chains, screen companies, validate fundamentals and technicals, reject fake narratives, and produce a risk-aware shortlist.

skills.name: a-share-stock-analysis
skills.description: Use when analyzing A-share market data, hotspots, individual stocks, user holdings, market risk, or evidence-based trade decision support.

skills.name: serenity-alpha
skills.description: Use when translating market news, product launches, demand changes, supply-chain clues, or technology breakthroughs into investable alpha hypotheses and validation paths.

skills.name: bayesian-intrinsic-growth-valuation
skills.description: Use when evaluating a company's intrinsic 3-5 year growth with Bayesian hypothesis updates, market-implied growth, valuation, FOMO, fundamentals, TAM, and industry-cycle evidence.

skills.name: gf-dma-health-index
skills.description: Use when scoring whether a stock's valuation and trend health are supported by fundamental growth, DMA structure, divergence, escape ratio, and estimate revisions.

skills.name: tam-adj-peg
skills.description: Use when evaluating growth-stock valuation with TAM-adjusted PEG, growth runway, business quality, pricing power, cyclicality, dilution, and execution risk.

skills.name: buy-side-equity-research-memo
skills.description: Use when generating source-backed buy-side equity research memos, investment committee notes, target-price scenarios, SOTP analysis, catalysts, risks, and monitoring dashboards.
